name: contains_water
query: MATCH (v:passage) WHERE v.passage.text CONTAINS "water" RETURN id(v) AS vid, v.passage.text AS text LIMIT 10;

name: contains_new_york
query: MATCH (v:passage) WHERE v.passage.text CONTAINS "New York" RETURN id(v) AS vid, v.passage.text AS text LIMIT 10;

name: starts_with_the_united
query: MATCH (v:passage) WHERE v.passage.text STARTS WITH "The United" RETURN id(v) AS vid, v.passage.text AS text LIMIT 10;

name: ends_with_water
query: MATCH (v:passage) WHERE v.passage.text ENDS WITH "water." RETURN id(v) AS vid, v.passage.text AS text LIMIT 10;
